Recollia 3.3 build check

The phone and offline version: no login, nothing to install. Your choices stay on this device until you press Send my review.
0 of 0 built items checked 0 work 0 need a change 0 broken 0 to remove 0 wanted from what is not built

Start here: five minutes
  1. Pick an item in Priority order (the top group matters most), or switch to By area to walk the product from the landing page to the report.
  2. See it opens a screenshot of that feature. How to check says how to try it in the app.
  3. Vote under “Your priority”: must have now, should have, nice later, or not needed. Only you can change your vote.
  4. Mark built items Works, Needs a change or Broken, and Keep or Remove.
  5. Say why: type a note and press Enter. Something missing? Add an item. When you are done, press Send my review at the top and send it by WhatsApp or email.

Your priority on each item says whether it has to be there and how soon: Must have now (needed for the beta), Should have, Nice, later or Not needed. Everyone votes for themselves; the badge shows the team’s view, dashed while it is only my suggestion, and “split” when people disagree. Priority order sorts everything by those votes, with broken and missing things first in each group; To do shows only what needs work.

For each item: try it, then mark Works, Needs a change or Broken, and say whether to Keep or Remove it. For things not in the build, say whether you want them. Type a note and press Enter to add it (Shift+Enter for a new line); notes show who wrote them. Comment opens a thread the whole team can reply to. Choices save as you make them and everyone sees the same board.
